affected_subject.reason: Identifies L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange and its Uniswap deadline argument.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as deadline.

direct_effect.reason: Deadline check becomes a no-op, allowing delayed transactions to be executed later by MEV actors.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected deadline protection vs actual no-op comparison of block.timestamp to itself.

summary: Report identifies the function, the block.timestamp deadline misuse, the no-op deadline effect, and the expected-vs-actual safety relation, sufficient to derive P/I/V.
